fields.climate: tropical; rainy season (May to October); dry season (November to April); tropical on coast; temperate in uplands
fields.terrain: mostly mountains with narrow coastal belt and central plateau
fields.hazards: known as the Land of Volcanoes; frequent and sometimes destructive earthquakes and volcanic activity; extremely susceptible to hurricanes; volcanism: significant volcanic activity…
fields.resources: hydropower, geothermal power, petroleum, arable land
fields.farm: sugarcane, maize, milk, chicken, sorghum, beans, oranges, coconuts, eggs, mangoes/guavas
fields.exports: garments, plastic products, electrical capacitors, raw sugar, toilet paper
fields.industries: food processing, beverages, petroleum, chemicals, fertilizer, textiles, furniture, light metals
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 43.9%, Protestant 39.6% (Evangelical - unspecified 38.2%, Evangelical - Methodist 1.3%, Evangelical - Baptist 0.1%), none 16.3%, unspecified 0.2%
fields.legal: civil law system with minor common law influence; Supreme Court reviews legislative acts
fields.military: 18-30 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women (17-22 for military schools); men are subject to selective compulsory military service; service obligation up to 18 months
